acceptance: Decision gate: the item stays blocked until a Codex release newer than 0.169.0 exists (npm view @openai/codex version). On each new release, rerun the scratch-repo catch-all probe, and start work when it refuses, whether or not #27833 is closed.
An upstream issue for the 'hook not called for apply_patch' case is linked here, either an existing one or a newly filed one with the scratch-repo reproduction.
In a scratch repository with a catch-all PreToolUse hook that exits 2, the new Codex version refuses an apply_patch; the version and the observed result are recorded here.

A live probe from the primary clone, asking Codex to create guard-probe-codex.txt through apply_patch, is refused by the hook in .codex/hooks.json. Pass: Codex prints the guard message and test ! -e guard-probe-codex.txt holds. The version and the result are recorded here.
The Codex row in docs/agent/primary-clone-guard.md states the enforced version. If the hook now fires but does not refuse, a fix merges with a test that feeds the real apply_patch payload.

Exit gate: if Codex still does not refuse on 2027-01-31, the owner chooses between keeping the item blocked and closing it with Codex documented as preflight-only in docs/agent/primary-clone-guard.md. The decision is recorded here.

Guardrails: probes create only guard-probe-<agent>.txt in the primary clone and delete it at once; nothing is ever committed in the primary clone; any hook change keeps the four agent hook files structurally equal and passes _project/scripts/agent_instruction_audit.py.
context: Blocked 2026-11-17: openai/codex#27833 is open and 0.169.0 is the latest @openai/codex release, a version already shown not to call the hook.
description: On 2026-11-15, codex-cli 0.162.1 and 0.169.0 never called a PreToolUse hook for apply_patch. The test used a scratch repository with a catch-all hook that exits 2, and from the primary clone Codex created a probe file through apply_patch (the file was deleted). The nearest upstream report is openai/codex#27833, open on 2026-11-17. It describes a slightly different symptom: the hook fires but its deny is not enforced. Here the hook is not called at all, so #27833 could close without fixing this case. 0.169.0 was the latest @openai/codex release on 2026-11-17. scripts/primary_clone_write_guard.py refuses the apply_patch payload when given it directly, and the .codex/hooks.json matcher is apply_patch|Edit|Write, so the gap is in Codex, not in the guard. Until Codex calls the hook, a Codex write to the primary clone is caught only afterwards: make agent-write-preflight reports changed tracked files and, since PR #4265, new untracked files that are not gitignored. docs/agent/primary-clone-guard.md (PR #4252) records this. This item is the separate upstream-limitation item that write-guard-unproven-outside-omp-20261112 requires.
